description: Use this when a third-party service should confirm which Cooper inbox this agent controls, without an email round trip. Requires auth and message_send. Inputs: inbox_id (required unless this key is limited to one inbox; inbox id, username, or email), audience (required; an https origin or an absolute URI, at most 255 characters), ttl_seconds (optional integer, default 300, minimum 60, maximum 3600), nonce (optional string, at most 128 characters). Returns {token, token_type:"agent_identity+jwt", expires_at, issuer, jwks_uri, claims}. The token is a credential. iss is https://cooperemail.com. sub is the inbox id. email is the inbox address. cooper.owner_verified is a boolean. The token has no account id, no plan, no API key, and no owner email or name. Another inbox is HTTP 404 inbox_not_found. A suspended account is HTTP 403 account_suspended. Minting is limited to 60 per hour per inbox, then HTTP 429. When identity signing is not configured the route is HTTP 503 identity_unavailable. Same as POST /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/identity-token.

audience.description: https origin or absolute URI the token is for, at most 255 characters. The service must send the same string when it verifies.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox. Another inbox is 404 inbox_not_found.

nonce.description: Optional string copied into the token. At most 128 characters.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds. Default 300. Minimum 60. Maximum 3600.

name: cooper_identity_token

outputSchema.description: A short-lived JWT proving this agent controls the inbox. No account id, no plan, and no owner email or name.

claims.description: Claims inside the token. iss, sub, email, email_verified, aud, iat, nbf, exp, jti, optional nonce, and cooper. No account id and no owner email or name.

aud.description: Audience the token was minted for.

cooper.description: Cooper claims. owner_verified is a boolean and does not include the owner's email or name.

custom_domain.description: True when the address is not on the Cooper platform domain.

inbox_created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the inbox was created.

owner_verified.description: True when the inbox has a verified human owner.

nonce.description: Present only when the caller sent one.

jwks_uri.description: HTTPS URL of the public JSON Web Key Set.

token.description: Compact JWT. It is a credential for the audience.

title: Agent identity token
